samenvatting: A second pulse source for the datanet was switched on at dag 10 02:40 without a verified register approval. Afterwards anomalies were logged: message degradation at 04:50 on dag 10 (ENG-107), and a poort oost shield opening with 3 minutes of outbound leak at dag 22 04:15 (ENG-026, GUA-043). Recurring 04:xx animal unrest and oracle-noted heavy nights point to a four-day rhythm (BEA-113, ORA-110 to ORA-142). Timestamp inversions in HIS-035, HIS-036 and HIS-053 remain unexplained. The council found no evidence of an intruder, but could not rule out a clock-beat fault or intrusion.

ingreep.bewering: The activation of a second, unsynchronised datanet pulse source at dag 10 02:40 is the triggering intervention.

mechanisme.bewering: Traffic arriving between two taps of the shield pulse is treated as internal under Art. 3 (GUA-104), so a second pulse can shift timing and let shields open from inside, admitting traffic unchecked.

verloop.bewering: After activation, an anomalous synchronisation event occurred at 04:50 on dag 10 (ENG-107, HIS-036), followed by a poort oost shield opening at dag 22 04:15 (ENG-026, GUA-043), with matching animal unrest the same minute (BEA-046).

acties.actie: Make a full copy of the register and the current pols configuration before any adjustment.
acties.reden: HIS-110 requires a backup before merging pols, and warns that sudden loss of a pols destroys records.

acties.actie: Verify the timestamps of HIS-035, HIS-036 and HIS-053 against original sources before relying on them.
acties.reden: vastgelegd_op values precede or follow gebeurd_op in ways that violate HIS-103.

acties.actie: Adjust the tempo of the hulpslag gradually in steps of 0,1%, without shutting the second pulse off abruptly.
acties.reden: ENG-114 sets 0,1% steps so that adjustment proceeds without shock; ENG-062 shows amplification is the wrong knob.

acties.actie: Keep the shields under watch with interim patrols at poort oost and the benedenstad, and resume rounds during 03:00 to 06:00.
acties.reden: GUA-106 shows no rounds in that window, and GUA-043 and GUA-019 record internal openings.

acties.actie: Monitor the 04:15 to 04:50 window on dag 46 for animal unrest and shield or message anomalies.
acties.reden: The four-day series predicts a recurrence at dag 46; verifying it tests the forecast.

acties.actie: Review the approval chain for the off-register instruction and record the authorising party.
acties.reden: ENG-105 gives no name or register entry, and ARC-106 authorised a pulse without recorded higher authority.

risicos.risico: Abrupt shutdown of the second pulse destroys records or disturbs the shields.
risicos.mitigatie: Copy the register first and change tempo only in 0,1% steps.

risicos.risico: An intruder exploits the internal-traffic gap during pulse shifts.
risicos.mitigatie: Interim shield patrols, seal inspection, and firewall checks (ENG-027).

risicos.risico: Conflicting instructions (ARC-106 permits, ARC-109 and ARC-116 advise shutdown) cause inconsistent operations.
risicos.mitigatie: Issue one written instruction that explicitly withdraws or confirms ARC-106.

risicos.risico: Unverified timestamps undermine the forensic record.
risicos.mitigatie: Audit vastgelegd_op against gebeurd_op for all disputed entries.

risicos.risico: Political pressure from off-register approval erodes trust in the council.
risicos.mitigatie: Publish the approval chain and its evidence gaps openly.

voorspelling.bewering: Four-day rhythm from dag 42: 42 + 4 = 46, with heavy-night and unrest recurrence around 04:30 (ORA-142, BEA-091/092).
